title: Bath & Body Works’ CEO Daniel Heaf and Mindy Grossman on Driving Transformation
summary: At Beauty Inc's Catalysts, CEO Daniel Heaf and retail veteran Mindy Grossman explored how transformation, culture change, product innovation and AI are reshaping Bath & Body Works.

extraction.key_fact: 배스앤바디웍스 경영진이 혁신과 AI가 회사를 바꾸는 방식을 이야기했다.
